I am delighted to welcome you to Melcombe Primary School.
We are a one-form entry school located within the London Borough of Hammersmith & Fulham and we serve the most wonderful children and their families. Since September 2019, we have been a part of the Thames Federation.
When you visit Melcombe Primary School, you will notice how special our school is. Our community is diverse, harmonious and vibrant, pupils are confident, polite and happy. Every child is valued and, regardless of their starting points in life, we have the highest expectations for each of them.
The staff are dedicated to the children and, in order to provide the very best education, they work closely with parents and carers to develop strong partnerships.
Our vision is simple and underpinned by a clear moral purpose; to lay firm foundations for excellence and achieve high expectations for all our pupils.
Thank you for taking the time to visit the Melcombe Primary School website.
Anne-Marie StrachanExecutive Head TeacherThe Thames Federation

Breakfast Club
Melcombe Primary School offers a Breakfast Club every day from 8.00am to 9.00am.
Regular attendees are charged £3.00 per session. One-off emergency bookings cost £5.00 per session. There is the facility to request an earlier drop off time of 7.30am if needed.
Bookings and payments are made through ParentMail.
To view the current booking form on ParentMail, please log in at: www.parentmail.co.uk
If you require any further information regarding our Breakfast Club facilities, please email our Breakfast Club leader, Ms Veronica Adeleye at vadeleye@melcombe.lbhf.sch.uk
ParentMail

pageCache.pageTitle: Melcombe Primary School - After School Clubs
pageCache.text:
After School ClubS
A variety of clubs take place at the end of the school day for children from Reception to Year 6.
These range from Street Dance and Yoga to Mathletics and Creative Writing. Sporting clubs are also available.
The majority of our after school sports clubs are run by coaches from Fulham Football Club Foundation (FFCF) who also provide the teaching of PE during the school day.
Most clubs run for a 10 week period during each term and cost between £3.00 and £4.50 per session.
The list of available clubs for each age group is emailed to parents and carers via ParentMail before the end of each term. Bookings and payments are then made through ParentMail.
If you require any further information regarding clubs, please email clubs@melcombe.lbhf.sch.uk

pageCache.pageTitle: Melcombe Primary School - After School Care
pageCache.text:
After School Care
Melcombe Primary School provides After School Care everyday from 3.15pm to 6.30pm.
When clubs are running, parents and carers can choose to enrol their child in a club and when the club finishes at 4.30pm, their child can go straight to After School Care.
Costs are as follows:
Session 1: 3.15pm – 6.30pm - £12.00 per session
Session 2: 4.30pm – 6.30pm - £8.00 per session
Bookings and payments are made through ParentMail.
To view the current booking form, please log in to ParentMail.
If you require any further information regarding our After School Care facilities, please email clubs@melcombe.lbhf.sch.uk
NB. Melcombe is registered with various childcare voucher schemes (Edenred, Computershare, Sodexo and HMRC). These vouchers can be used to pay wholly or partially for any Extended Day activities. These include Breakfast Club, After School Care and After School Clubs.

Friends of Melcombe
Friends of Melcombe exists as a liaison between the teachers, students and families all working together to strengthen the Melcombe community and create an enjoyable learning environment for Melcombe children.
As a community, we are committed to providing a range of activities that are designed to support the school. The primary goals of Friends of Melcombe are to generate additional funds for the school through fundraising events and projects, as well as creating opportunities for families to socialise and get to know each other better.
Send your feedback, comments or ideas to hello@friendsofmelcombe.org

ParentMail
Melcombe Primary School and the Melcombe Nursery use ParentMail, an online communications and payments system, to contact parents and carers by email and text.
Parents and carers download the free ParentMail app to their mobile phone from Google Play or the App Store to access all the advantages of ParentMail, enabling them to complete online forms from the school and make hassle-free online payments for school dinners, breakfast club, afterschool clubs and afterschool care using the system.
ParentMail can also be accessed on a desktop computer or tablet at https://www.parentmail.co.uk.
Parents and carers will be sent a link to register for an account for their child when they start at Melcombe Primary School or Nursery. If parents and carers are already registered with ParentMail for a child at another school, they do not need to re-regsiter and can add their child attending Melcombe to their existing account.
ParentMail

Reporting Absence
At Melcombe Primary School, we believe that children must attend school unless they are unwell or there are special circumstances that have been cleared with the Headteacher. Research has shown that children have better life chances if they attend school regularly. At Melcombe, we reward excellent attendance and punctuality. Our expectation of school attendance is 100%.
In the event of a child’s absence, their parent or carer must telephone the School Office (020 8748 7411) or email our Attendance Officer, Phoebe Wight, at pwight@melcombe.lbhf.sch.uk before 9.00am on the first day of absence. This should be followed up with a letter or supporting documentation (hospital letter, prescriptions, GP appointment cards, appointment text shown to the Admin team) on the child’s return to school.
If absence of a child is requested due to special circumstances, this should be put in writing, at least two weeks in advance, to Ms Campbell. Each request will be dealt with individually, taking into account the reasons for the request, the time of year, the disruption to the child’s learning and the child’s attendance history. Persistent absence with no explanation may result in a referral to London Borough of Hammersmith & Fulham’s Education Welfare Department, which could result in a fine.

School Uniform
School uniform is compulsory at Melcombe Primary School as it helps to promote a positive ethos of belonging within the community. Therefore from September 2026, pupils will be required to wear the following items which adheres to the DfE's Cost of School Uniform guidance. This ensures that Melcombe's uniform remains affordable for all families attending the school:
EYFs, KS1 & KS2 Uniform
All items of clothing must be clearly labelled with the child’s name and class.
Clothing grants to help parents buy school uniforms are available from the local authority for pupils whose parents or carers receive certain benefits.
To check eligibility and create an online account with London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham to apply, visit:
https://www.lbhf.gov.uk/benefits/student-benefits-and-grants
